Privacy Policy

Effective date placeholder: [EFFECTIVE DATE]

This privacy policy is a general website template for a childcare inquiry website and should be reviewed and updated before publication.

Information Collected

We may collect parent or guardian contact details and childcare inquiry information submitted through this website.

How Information Is Used

Information is used to respond to inquiries, discuss care options, and communicate enrollment-related updates.

Contact-Form Submissions

Form submissions may be processed by a third-party form service selected by the daycare, such as Formspree or Web3Forms.

Information About Children

Families should only share information necessary for childcare inquiry and enrollment steps. Additional records are handled through official enrollment documentation.

Data Retention

Inquiry data is retained only as long as reasonably needed for communication and recordkeeping.

Cookies and Analytics

This website may use basic cookies or analytics tools. Update this section if analytics or tracking tools are added.

Information Security

Reasonable measures are used to protect inquiry information, but no online transmission is guaranteed to be fully secure.

Parent or Guardian Rights

Parents or guardians may request updates or corrections to inquiry information by contacting the daycare directly.
